bio: Grade II listed, the 18th century lodge is full of character and set back along a meandering drive, amongst eight acres of beautiful gardens.  From an afternoon on the beautiful New Forest terrace, to the sun-trap orangery they have just the perfect setting for your afternoon of sweets and savouries – with a delightful savoury tier, freshly baked scones, accompanied by preserves and brightly coloured sweets to top of your three-tiered stand.  Take a seat and enjoy a beautifully hand crafted Alice in Wonderland Afternoon Tea, served with specialist teas and themed home-baked patisserie treats at the wonderful Bartley Lodge  Not forgetting the little ones, they have specially designed afternoon tea with all the favourites and a little fun activity to keep them entertained.
